dedupe_keys.name: traficom ncsc fi autoreporter statistics malware and security breach observations in finnish networks

description: Autoreporter is a service of the National Cyber Security Centre Finland (NCSC-FI), part of Traficom, which collects observations of malware infections and information security breaches in Finnish networks from many sources and reports them automatically to the network operators concerned so they can act. Traficom publishes statistics from the service as open data in JSON through its OData v4 interface, in local time and in a separate UTC version, with a page describing the Autoreporter categories. The statistics show numbers of observations over time by category, such as malware, botnets, spam sources, scanning and open services that can be abused, for networks in Finland. The dataset has been on the national open data portal since November 2016 under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Coverage: Finnish networks (IP address space registered to Finnish organisations). Format and access: JSON via OData v4, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: observation counts depend on the external feeds Autoreporter uses and are not a complete picture of incidents; category definitions may change. Simulation uses: base rates of compromised devices and abusable services in a national network, for cyber threat scenarios against telecom and other infrastructure. Related records: the CERT.br and BACS statistics are comparable national series, and the Traficom communications open data record lists the interface.
name: Traficom NCSC-FI Autoreporter statistics: malware and security breach observations in Finnish networks
notes: Portal metadata read through the avoindata.suomi.fi CKAN API and the Traficom open data page read with curl on 2026-09-26 (description, JSON resources, UTC version, categories page, licence). The example categories and the sources of observations are from recall.
